services.name: EBT Access Program
services.desc: The EBT Access Program will provide individuals across Los Angeles County discounted tickets to select shows across the season, this effort reflects the LA Phil’s core values of access and equity, underscoring our commitment to ensuring that the arts are available to all. You will receive a confirmation email with guidelines on how to use the program. Approval can take up to two business days. If approved, you will then be able to purchase discounted tickets.
